feed.title: Four of seven Hilton openings are conversions
feed.summary: Hilton Worldwide Holdings is adding seven new properties in the U.S., with four being conversions or rebrands of existing hotels, and three being new builds. Only two of these properties will be managed directly by Hilton, while others will be franchised or partner-operated. This mix reflects a trend towards conversions, which are expected to account for a significant portion of Hilton's global openings in 2026.

feed.title: Rockwell Automation Report Highlights Shift to Continuous Readiness in Life Sciences Manufacturing
feed.summary: A new Rockwell Automation report reveals a significant shift in life sciences manufacturing towards continuous operational readiness, driven by digital technologies. The report, "The New Operating Model for Life Sciences Manufacturing," highlights that 90% of life sciences manufacturers deem digital transformation essential, with a focus on leveraging AI, process automation, and cybersecurity to improve quality, digitize operations, and reduce risk. It also addresses the challenges of AI adoption due to data readiness and the increasing threat of cyberattacks, outlining steps for manufacturers to achieve continuous readiness.

feed.title: L3Harris Lands $6B+ THAAD Propulsion Contract From Lockheed Martin: Here’s What Investors Need To Know
feed.summary: L3Harris Technologies secured an undefinitized contract worth over $6 billion from Lockheed Martin to significantly expand propulsion production for the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) system. This involves building a new facility for THAAD Solid Rocket Boost Motor production and expanding capacity for Liquid Divert and Attitude Control systems. This contract follows a separate $4.7 billion PAC-3 MSE propulsion contract, reinforcing L3Harris's growing role in missile defense manufacturing.

feed.title: BD marks 70 years at Utah medtech manufacturing site
feed.summary: BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) recently celebrated 70 years of manufacturing at its Sandy, Utah facility, a key site for producing peripheral intravenous (IV) catheters. The 650,000 sq ft facility, which employs over 1,000 people, is critical to the global supply of medical technologies. BD has invested more than $100 million in the site over the last five years, demonstrating its commitment to U.S. manufacturing and supporting healthcare systems worldwide.

feed.title: SLB, Formentera Working to Activate Drilling Rigs in Venezuela, Executives Say
feed.summary: Oil service provider SLB and private equity firm Formentera Partners are actively working to reactivate or import drilling rigs into Venezuela to boost its crude production capacity. Despite current obstacles like importing equipment and negotiating with the Venezuelan government, SLB anticipates reactivating up to 15 rigs within a year, with a few expected to be operational by year-end, while Formentera is in discussions with international service providers for additional rigs. This effort comes as Venezuela seeks to expand its oil production, though challenges related to power supply, supply chains, and contract protection remain.

feed.title: Court Narrows Claims in Archer–Joby Legal Dispute
